data.name: Social Presence
data.description: A courtly knight gains a +%1 bonus on all Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks.  A courtly knight starts any verbal duel (see Ultimate Intrigue page 176) with an extra edge she can use for only the presence tactic unless she is at a significant or extreme disadvantage in the duel.|CourtlyKnightSocialPresence
